K={n:ast.literal_eval(re.search(rf'^K{n} = (b.*)$', s, re.M).group(1)) for n in range(1,7)}
def f(a,b,c,d):
    return (a&b&c&d | a&(b^1)&(c^1)&d | a&(b^1)&c&(d^1) | a&b&(c^1)&(d^1) | (a^1)&b&(c^1)&d | (a^1)&b&c&(d^1))
M=73
p=pwn.remote('target',5000)
line=p.recvuntil(b'Enjoy this random bits : ').decode()
bits=p.recvline().strip().decode()
iv=[int(c) for c in bits]
print(len(iv))
inp=bytearray(M*M); bad=0
for i in range(M):
    for q in range(M):
        for b in range(8):
            K1,K2,K3,K4,K5,K6=[(K[n][q]>>b)&1 for n in (1,2,3,4,5,6)]
            good=[]
            for x in (0,1):
                inner=f(x,iv[i],K5,K6)
                ok=all(f(st,f(k,inner,K3,K4),K1,K2)==(st^k) for st in (0,1) for k in (0,1))
                if ok: good.append(x)
            if len(good)!=1: bad+=1; x=0
            else: x=good[0]
            inp[i*M+q] |= (x<<b)
print('bad',bad)
p.sendline(bytes(inp).hex().encode())
print(p.recvall(timeout=5).decode(errors='replace')[:800])
